notes.title: Super Monkey Ball: Banana Blitz HD's latest Steam patch lets you ride inside a cube
notes.notes: For reasons unclear (but not unappreciated), Sega has released a new update for Super Monkey Ball: Banana Blitz HD on Steam, enabling players to ditch their traditional roly-poly spheres and take a tumble using rather less ergonomic cubes, triangles, and even stars.Sega announced the new feature over on Super Monkey Ball's Japanese Twitter page, explaining that AiAi's traditionally spherical mode of transport can be altered while on the game's character select screen by typing "cube", "triangle", or "star" with a keyboard. If all goes well, you should hear a confirmatory sound effect.According to Sega, the feature will only work during Super Monkey Ball: Banana Blitz HD's main game, and there are no guarantees that it'll be possible to clear every stage while tumbling around in a non-regulation Monkey Ball. In order to return to AiAi's regular ride, players simply need to exit the main game or enter "sphere" while on the character select screen.Read more

notes.title: Think Outside the Ball in Super Monkey Ball: Banana Blitz’s New Update!
notes.notes:
Maybe you spend your days trapped in a grey office cube...

And your personal life is a tortured soap-opera love triangle...

But when you get home and step into your monkey shoes, you’ve got what it takes to be a star!

We’ve added a quite silly bonus feature to Super Monkey Ball: Banana Blitz HD’s Main Game. Think you can find it? Hint: Try channeling your inner monkey-at-a-typewriter and start banging out some words...

We look forward to seeing your results!

If you run into any issues or bugs, please let us know here!
